Thanking God President Trump is safe tonight.


Fox News (@FoxNews)

PRESIDENT TRUMP: “The man has been captured. They’re going to his apartment, I guess he lives in California. And he's a sick person, a very sick person. And we don't want things like this to happen.”

Video

They keep trying to stop President Trump. They keep failing. Enough is enough. 

STOP THE POLITICAL VIOLENCE.

Video

Tonight, once again, they tried. And once again, they failed. God was looking after President Trump tonight.

STOP TRYING TO SHOOT HIM.

This is America. We settle our differences at the ballot box - not with bullets.

Right now, we are praying for the safety of President Trump and the members of the administration attending the White House Correspondents Association Dinner after gunshots were fired. We are hearing reports the shooter has been apprehended and President Trump will be returning to dinner. We are continuing to monitor the situation and will provide updates as more information becomes available.
Please get on your knees and pray for President Trump and for our country right now.

The DHS shutdown is now the longest in history.

It is FAR past time the Senate passes the funding bill. Our national security is at risk. Federal workers are struggling. 

Enough is enough. Get it passed now.

The heartbeat of this country runs right through South Carolina. 

Our veterans, our farmers, our law enforcement, our small business owners. They are the backbone of America and the reason we work so hard in Washington every single day. 

You sent us to represent YOU.  The people of the Lowcountry. We will never stop standing up for you. 

South Carolina STRONG.

Our democracy is being stolen and the Senate is letting it happen.

It is far past time everyone in our government starts putting America first.

PASS THE SAVE AMERICA ACT. Secure our elections.

Congratulations to Monroe Freeling for being selected in the first round of this year's NFL draft by the Carolina Panthers. You're dedication, commitment and hard work has gotten you to this point. You've earned it.

From right here in Mount Pleasant, to now representing SC01 on the national level. Play hard, give 'em hell, and show everyone what South Carolina is made of.

South Carolina STRONG.


NFL on ESPN (@ESPNNFL)

Monroe Freeling is headed to Carolina with the 19th pick 💪

Video

Taxpayers are funding federal labs to experiment on animals, and when the research ends, those same labs put them down instead of finding them a home. 

We filed an amendment to the Farm Bill, based on our bill, Violet's Law, to require federal research facilities to establish standards for the adoption or non-laboratory placement of animals no longer needed for research.

These animals should be given a second chance at life. A healthy animal deserves a home, not a death sentence. This amendmen

Our office met with Stephanie Rossi, Planning Director for the Lowcountry Council of Governments, to talk about their planning and transportation priorities.

Building strong partnerships like this in the Lowcountry is how we deliver real investments and real results.

South Carolina STRONG.

South Carolina families who rely on SNAP should never have to wonder if their benefits are safe. Taxpayers are tired of watching their hard-earned dollars fund fraud while Washington looks the other way. This ends now. 

Our amendment to the Farm Bill requires a photo on every SNAP EBT card and mandates identity verification at every transaction. It is common sense: your photo is on the card, and you are the only one who uses it. Plain and simple.
